tools.name: ask_questions
tools.description: Get BuildBatch's ordered question script before planning. Ask only what applies, use measurements the person gives you, and do not guess a missing measurement.

tools.name: plan_room
tools.description: Work out the whole shopping list for one room from the person's answers. Arguments are the same named parameters as /plan.json. A job is required. Repeated door, window and opening values are arrays. No price is used; price arguments are ignored and named in the answer.
